audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side is a flat "Skill" template on all 7 rows while content win[] already names Janna favored levels 1-6 and Yuumi only at 2+ items -- the layers disagree on every row.
audit.why: Janna's kit is entirely reactive (shield/slow/knockback) until Monsoon at 6, but her poke-avoidance and disengage tools out-tempo an attached Yuumi through lane; late-game the unkillable saddle out-values her pure peel.
audit.corrected: Moved side to Janna for rows 0-5 and Yuumi for row 6 to match win[], with why grounded per stage.

audit.why: Level 6 (Monsoon) and the late unkillable-saddle spike are already correctly flagged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Monsoon heals through chip damage, making Grievous Wounds timing decisive.
audit.why: Monsoon is a heal/knockback zone; sustained poke alone loses value once she can heal it back.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[1] to state the anti-heal timing directly.

audit.why: Field exists to hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Howling Gale 14s flat and Monsoon 130-100s.

edits.before: Poke from the saddle — the attached Q steers and the lane can't bill you for it.
edits.after: Howling Gale is a slow charge on 14s CD -- your poke lands free while she winds up.

edits.before: Dismount windows begin: the passive autos shield and heal; schedule them carefully.
edits.after: Zephyr's slow only matters after a hit; you outpoke her before her shield lands.

edits.before: Full rhythm: attach for the trades, dismount for the passive, never linger between.
edits.after: Eye of the Storm shields but doesn't threaten -- the poke race still favors you.

edits.before: Zoomies the margins — the host's tempo is your tempo; bank the chip.
edits.after: She stays peel-first; your Zoomies resets out-tempo her with no real answer.

edits.before: Final Chapter online — the root waves referee every dive on your host.
edits.after: Monsoon heals and knocks back everything -- any all-in gets undone and healed.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the steered Qs chunk.
edits.after: Sustain items outheal what your kit can burst down.

edits.before: Late Yuumi is the unkillable second health bar: attach, amplify, and out-vote the focus fire.
edits.after: Late Yuumi is the unkillable second health bar: attach, amplify, and out-vote her disengage.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W attach (untargetability) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: Howling Gale (Q) is a flat 14s cooldown charge-up -- bait the cast before your duo commits to anything. Monsoon (R) is 130-100s and heals plus knocks back everything nearby; anti-heal timing decides whether your all-in actually survives the cast.

edits.before: Dismount windows are scheduled, not improvised — the cat on foot is everyone's favorite headline.
edits.after: Grievous Wounds timing matters -- Monsoon heals through chip damage, so land it before a long fight.

notes: No your-channel-punished or shield-absorbs-burst interaction exists for Janna per missingInteractions -- her kit has no hard CC to cancel Final Chapter with, so tradeBad/dosFull/dontsFull bleed pairs were left as-is rather than inventing an interrupt that doesn't apply.
